entries.original: Sidearms with a gray background are currently in a colonists inventory and eligible for use. Right click to drop.
entries.text: 灰色背景的副武器当前位于殖民者随身物品中，可以使用。右键点击可丢下。

entries.original:
Colonists can have sidearm use configured on an individual basis. The options are: 
Use ranged weapons
Use weapons colonist is passionate about or skilled with 
Use melee weapons
entries.text:
可分别设置每名殖民者的副武器偏好：
使用远程武器；
使用角色有激情或更擅长的武器；
使用近战武器。

entries.original:
Left click a carried ranged weapon to set it as the default ranged weapon. If the colonist weapon preference is set to ranged (or skill on a colonist more skilled with ranged weapons), this weapon will be what the colonist equips when not in active combat. It will also be used while hunting. 

Click a default ranged weapon again to force its use regardless of range/DPS. 

Right click to remove forced use/default status.
entries.text:
左键点击携带的远程武器，将其设为默认远程武器。若角色偏好远程（或偏好按技能选择，且射击技能更高），不在主动交战时会装备它，狩猎时也会使用它。

再次点击默认远程武器，可强制使用它而不考虑距离或每秒伤害（DPS）。

右键点击取消强制使用或默认状态。

entries.original:
Left click a carried melee weapon to set it as the preferred ranged weapon. The colonist will always use this weapon when weapon preference is set to melee (or skill on a colonist more skilled with melee weapons) and when forced into close combat. 

Click a preferred melee weapon again to force its use at all times. 

Right click to remove forced use/preference.
entries.text:
左键点击携带的近战武器，将其设为偏好近战武器。角色偏好近战（或按技能选择且近战技能更高）以及被迫进入近身战斗时，都会使用它。

再次点击偏好近战武器，可强制始终使用它。

右键点击取消强制使用或偏好状态。

entries.original: Left click a carried weapon while drafted to force its use until end of combat. \n\nNote that most changes to sidearm loadout require the pawn to not be drafted.
entries.text:
征召时左键点击携带的武器，可强制使用它直到战斗结束。

注意：多数副武器配置修改需要角色未被征召。

entries.original: Depending on the settings, Simple Sidearms can cause colonists to drop their weapons in a variety of situations (default is attacks in melee). Don't worry - your colonists will retrieve their weapons after the fight. \n\nThis is a customizable feature - take a look in the mod settings dialog to learn more.
entries.text:
根据设置，主副武器模组可能让殖民者在不同情况下丢下武器（默认发生于近战攻击）。不用担心，战斗结束后他们会重新拾取武器。

此功能可自定义，详情请查看模组设置。
